summary: Iteration 17 — Phase A Register Maker E2E test (backend + frontend). Backend pytest: 11/11 PASS (incl. live Gemini Flash AI study extracting 10 columns + 3 static fields with confidence 0.95 and ₹0.20 cost). Frontend Playwright E2E covered: admin login via /hrms/login, /register-maker/dashboard 3 tabs (rm-tab-overview/categories/templates), 4 stat tiles (rm-stat-categories/templates/ai-studied/ai-usage-so-far) with correct values, module-switcher-btn visible, Categories empty state CTA + New Category dialog (name/state/law/tags/desc) — created 'PYTEST UI Cat A' with Maharashtra + Minimum Wages Act + tags, Templates tab disabled state when no categories then enabled, Upload register template dialog (name/category/code/notes/file picker), real .xlsx upload, status badge transitioned to READY (₹0.20), TemplateDetailDialog showed FORM A badge + PER EMPLOYEE + MONTHLY + Confidence 95% + AI MODEL Gemini 3 Flash + TOKENS 1612 + COST ₹0.20 + 3 static fields with mappings + 10 data columns with type pills (NUMBER/TEXT/CURRENCY/DATE) + source hints + required ticks (rm-col-* count = 10). Stats refreshed live (cat=1, tpl=1, ai-studied=1, ai-usage=₹0.20). Cleanup of category + template successful. All 17 review_request cases verified GREEN.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening rm-cat-form-state / rm-cat-form-law / rm-tpl-form-category dropdowns triggers benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' warnings, which CRA dev-mode webpack-dev-server-client-overlay turns into a full-screen red error overlay that intercepts pointer events in the preview environment. In production builds this overlay does not exist, but it makes manual QA on the preview URL noticeably worse and blocked our Playwright clicks until we injected CSS to hide #webpack-dev-server-client-overlay. Consider patching the ResizeObserver no-op (e.g., wrap the global ResizeObserver to swallow this single message) so the dev overlay stays clean.

action_items: MEDIUM: silence the benign ResizeObserver loop warning emitted by Radix Select on open (e.g., monkey-patch window.ResizeObserver to swallow that single error message) so the CRA dev-overlay does not block clicks during manual QA on the preview URL. Production builds are unaffected.
LOW: tighten review_request testid spec — code uses kebab-case for state/law/tags/etc. and underscore-case for module keys; keep one convention if possible (carryover note from iter16).
critical_code_review_comments: register_maker/routes.py upload_template stores full file_b64 in Mongo for every upload (15MB limit). For an org uploading 100 templates that's up to 1.5 GB in a Mongo collection. Consider GridFS or S3 once Phase A leaves preview.
register_maker/routes.py list_categories runs an aggregation per request; fine at 500-cat scale but flag as N+1 risk if categories grow.
_study_template_bg writes ai_status='studying' twice on restudy path (once in restudy_template before queueing, once at start of bg task). Idempotent but redundant — a single write is enough.
RegisterMakerDashboard.js is a single-file SPA; consider splitting into Categories/Templates/Detail components when Phase B lands to avoid ballooning past 700 lines.

Category delete returns 400 on FK violation with HTTPException — good UX, but the 'Cannot delete' message is parsed via substring match in tests; consider returning structured {code:'has_templates', count:n} for stable client handling.
seed_data_creation: All PYTEST_-prefixed categories and templates created during this run were deleted at end of test (both pytest cleanup_at_end fixture and Playwright cleanup steps ran successfully). No leftover seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A is GREEN end-to-end. Backend test_register_maker.py is the canonical regression suite. Live AI calls cost ~₹0.20 per upload. The webpack-dev-server-client-overlay is a CRA preview-only overlay triggered by Radix Select's ResizeObserver — does not affect production. Phase B (compatibility check + register generation) and Phase C (cross-tenant template library) are NOT yet built and explicitly out of scope. Final DB state: PYTEST data cleaned. Stats endpoint will read 0/0/0/₹0 for that org.
rca of the issue: No bugs. Only environmental annoyance: CRA dev-overlay surfaces a benign Radix Select ResizeObserver warning. Mitigation: globally silence the specific ResizeObserver message via a tiny window.addEventListener('error',...) shim or wrap ResizeObserver constructor.
